home.title: Home
home.lead: Everything you make, in one place. Pick a section to start.

empty.status: This section is not available yet. It will arrive in a later release.
empty.via_projects: The video editor opens from a project. Open or create one in Projects.

projects.holds: Your productions: the brief, the media and everything you publish, project by project.

edit-video.holds: The video editor: timeline, captions, effects and export.

edit-image.holds: The image editor: layers, text and thumbnails.

write.holds: Scripts, copy and blog posts, written alone or with an agent.

visual-assets.holds: Images, logos and generated art that you reuse across projects.

video-assets.holds: Footage, clips, music and voice-overs that you reuse across projects.

publish.holds: The calendar of what goes out and the approval queue that waits for you.

skills.holds: Reusable skills that your agents can run.

memory.holds: What your agents remember about you, your brand and your projects.

connections.holds: Your social networks and AI providers, and the access you gave each one.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.intro: Publishing and costly generation wait here for you. An agent can prepare them; only you can say yes, or write a rule that says yes for you.
approvals.live: Live: new requests appear here by themselves.
approvals.offline: Not live: reload the page to see new requests.
approvals.cost_intro: A ceiling stops further spending, whoever approves it: raise it here first. A day is a UTC day.
approvals.no_ceilings: No ceilings: every costly request still waits for you.
approvals.ceiling_note: Leave both limits empty to remove the ceiling of that currency.

rules.title: Rules that approve for you
rules.intro: A rule lets a kind of action go without asking. Only you can write one; no agent can.
rules.empty: No rules: everything waits for you.
rules.limits: Most per item: {item}. Most per day: {day}.
rules.note: A rule with no limit per item never approves something that costs money.
rules.bad_amount: An amount is a number with at most six decimals, for example 2.50.
